notes:
- New: background auto-update — NexSion now checks for new releases on its own, even if you never open a new tab
- New: a system notification pops up the moment an update is out; click it to jump straight to Settings → Updates with the Install button ready — one click and you're done
- New: a small blinking dot appears on the Settings button whenever an update is waiting, so you notice it without digging through menus
- New: Auto-Update toggle in Settings → Updates — turn it on (after linking your update folder) and NexSion installs new versions completely on its own, showing a small progress toast in the corner of the screen while it updates
- Fixed: installing an update could grab whichever browser tab happened to be active and swap/close it, even if it wasn't a NexSion tab — it now only ever touches NexSion's own tabs
